title: [review] EDHOC PLAINTEXT_2/3 ID_CRED kid sent as {4: kid} map; RFC 9528 3.5.3.2 requires bare kid bstr
description: P3, found during gt6u fix. RFC 9528 3.5.3.2: ID_CRED_I/ID_CRED_R in PLAINTEXT_2/3 MUST be the bare kid (a CBOR bstr/int, with 3.3.2 transport rule applied), not the {4: kid} map form; both implementations currently send the map form for the 8-byte kid (python _encode_id_cred, rust credential.rs). Changes PLAINTEXT bytes -> transcript -> master_secret, so fixing requires coordinated fixture regen on both impls (same procedure as gt6u). Note the map form may be intentional for LICHEN (kid is an 8-byte EUI-derived value, and RFC allows map form in other ID_CRED usages) - verify against RFC 3.5.3 examples first; if map form is actually conformant where kid is used as ID_CRED content, close as invalid with the RFC citation.
